block_distribution_scope.aggregation: Within-block means over exactly five original forecast seeds; equal weights over 46 recording blocks.
block_distribution_scope.block_labels: Anonymous original rank plus one; no recording hashes, targets, coordinates or paths.
block_distribution_scope.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, p=0.25,0.5,0.75; inclusive sample quartiles, not confidence intervals.

scope.description: Post-outcome descriptive profiles for previously displayed Full/GMM/dt300. Equal block weights after within-block seed averaging. Marginal ensemble-mean radial disks, not highest-density or simultaneous path regions. Area alone is not a quality ranking; final qualification pending.
